FEATURES

We believe in building community and helping our members live better lives through play-and-earn blockchain's games. Our crypto guild maintains a portfolio of Non-Fungible Tokens ("NFT") game assets of top tier blockchain games which are then lent to our members who play with and earn along the way. While gamers at our heart, our team are also experienced operators skilled at execution, people management and Defi.

By serving as the gateway platform for gamers and NFT-owners, MetaLeagues serves as the union of capital and talent to meet.

FREQUENT ASKED QUESTIONS
  • How do I become a scholar and play for MetaLeagues?

    You can apply for a scholarship in our Discord channel. To apply for a scholarship, please join our Discord and follow the instructions provided, in the topic “Scholarship Application Form”. Our managers will be in touch with you for a short interview to assess your suitability to become a scholar!

  • How do I invest in MetaLeagues?

    We are open for our seed/private round investor. The public round will be conducted in once we concluded the seed round investor. More details on the public round will be announced! If you're a strategic investor and you're keen to invest in our private round, please reach out to us at our Discord or contract us at metaleagues@gmail.com

  • Where can I find out more about MetaLeagues?

    Our Gitbook outlines our guild strategy and plans. If you would like to know more or have any additional questions, come swing by our Discord channel and we'll be more than excited to share more with you!

  • When is the Launch Date for MetaLeagues ($MTL) Token?

    $MTL token *IS NOT LIVE YET. Please be careful of fake $MTL tokens and scam contract addresses. The token contract will be announced after our public round is completed and we'll announce the token contract on our website and social media channels for our community to verify.
